caption: The drawing is a rectangular, monochromatic composition rendered in a reddish-brown color. It features a central panel depicting a man dressed in 18th-century clothing, standing on a carpet between two large columns, with his left hand resting on a table that has a plumed hat on it and his right hand holding a sheathed sword. Above him, curtains drape from the top corners, with the words "THE EFFECT OF PRINCIPLE" and "BEHOLD THE MAN" written across the top. On either side of the man, there is printed text within bordered boxes; the left box contains a paragraph while the right box is headed “GEORGE WASHINGTON” and provides biographical details. The lower part of the drawing is divided into three sections: the left section has an eagle with outstretched wings clutching arrows and an olive branch over a shield, the center section shows a sailing ship on the ocean beneath the words "COMMERCIAL UNION," and the right section contains a lion lying down with a British flag, captioned "THE BRITISH LION." The entire detailed drawing is enclosed within a single-lined border, and the artist’s signature “J.V. LUBRAND” appears in the lower right corner. The background is plain and unmarked, with the drawing centered on the page.
title: Printed Textile - Historical  George Washington
